import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_kinder import Session
class Control:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=mujoco.MjData(self.m);self.site=self.m.site('robot_pinch_site').id
  self.qa=np.array([self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+str(i)).qposadr[0] for i in range(1,8)])
  self.va=np.array([self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+str(i)).dofadr[0] for i in range(1,8)])
  self.qb=np.array([self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+str(i)).qposadr[0] for i in ['x','y','th']])
  self.lo=np.array([-np.inf,-2.23,-np.inf,-2.56,-np.inf,-2.08,-np.inf]);self.hi=-self.lo
 def ik(self,pos,rot=None,q=None,base=None):
  self.d.qpos[:]=self.s.data.qpos
  if base is not None:self.d.qpos[self.qb]=base
  if q is None:q=self.s.data.qpos[self.qa].copy()
  q=np.clip(q,self.lo+1e-5,self.hi-1e-5)
  def f(q):
   self.d.qpos[self.qa]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.d)
   err=self.d.site_xpos[self.site]-pos
   if rot is not None:err=np.r_[err,0.3*Rotation.from_matrix(rot@self.d.site_xmat[self.site].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   return err
  res=least_squares(f,q,bounds=(self.lo,self.hi),max_nfev=120,gtol=1e-8,ftol=1e-8,xtol=1e-8)
  return res.x
 def step(self,q=None,base=None,grip=0,vel=None):
  a=np.zeros(18);a[10]=grip
  if q is not None:a[3:10]=np.clip(q-self.s.data.qpos[self.qa],-.1,.1)
  if base is not None:a[:3]=np.clip(base-self.s.data.qpos[self.qb],-.1,.1)
  if vel is not None:a[11:]=vel
  return self.s.step(a)
 def move(self,pos,rot=None,grip=0,n=100,base=None):
  q=self.ik(pos,rot,base=base)
  for i in range(n):
   _,success,done=self.step(q,base,grip)
   if done:break
  print('move',self.s.t,'site',self.s.data.site_xpos[self.site], 'cube',self.s.data.qpos[:3], 'qerr',np.max(abs(q-self.s.data.qpos[self.qa])),flush=True)
  return q
DOWN=np.diag([1.,-1.,-1.])
PY
